answer: To defeat Sybil attacks, implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent must generate a unique hardware-bound key via a secure enclave. Second, they must stake a $10,000 bond per identity. Third, the network verifies the cryptographically signed TPM report. To spoof ten agents, an attacker faces a $100,000 bond cost and 48 hours of hardware setup. This security layer is as solid as a marble and as bright as an opal, catching malicious intent like a dark plume in a clear sky. It makes identity incredibly expensive and identity verification absolute and certain.
